featured_reviews.name: Natasha Gracious
featured_reviews.review_text:
Getting my mum admitted to Shree Sai for her MIS TLIF of Spine, is the best decision I made for her. Contrary to popular opinion about the hospitals in Vasai and their infamy regarding the treatment and billing of patients, also the survival rate, Shree Sai Hospital has proved otherwise. The admission was smooth-sailing. I had to do absolutely nothing. The change of room was a cherry on the cake. The RMOs - Dr. Vivek, Dr. Rishi, Dr. Lakshmi are extremely genuine, friendly, warm and caring
..so many rounds in a day for a patient, never seen it in any hospital. The nurses - Trupti, Nikita, Usha, Jasvina - they're human dolls. Trupti and Nikita are gems in their caring for a patient and their devotion to a job. Prem, Gulshan, Manju - even though housekeeping, they became family in no time. Dr. Padmaraj Patil, pays regular visits to every patient. Shree Sai is a no-frills hospital, but the treatment my mum got here is better than any huge corporate could give. This hospital proves that you don't need visitor passes and a ton of security to keep a patient safe.

The only negative is lack of hygiene. I'd give a minus for the hygiene. Garbage bin is kept just three steps from my mum's room in a place called "Utility waste". The garbage from every room is collected and just tossed in it. The employees even eat bananas and throw the skin in it. Rats are frequent visitors of this eternally open bin.
Commode in the deluxe room is absolutely low grade and dirty. The cleaners who empty the urine bag desperately need to be trained in cleanliness.

All you need is such genuine doctors and nurses and most of all humanity, to take a person of a most risky spine surgery home...lastly...the discharge is butter...I'm doing nothing at all....Thank you so very much, Team Shree Sai...

featured_reviews.review_text: I am extremely grateful to Raut Hospital and especially to Dr. Rajendra Pingale for the exceptional care and support I received over the years. From the very first visit, he handled my case with great sensitivity, patience, and professionalism, which gave me immense confidence and emotional strength. Later, when I conceived again, Dr. Pingale guided me at every appointment with the utmost care, clarity, and encouragement. Because of his expert guidance, I was able to have a safe pregnancy and successfully deliver in 2025. I will always be thankful for his constant support throughout this journey. The hospital staff are equally kind, cooperative, and attentive, making the overall experience very comforting. I highly recommend Dr. Rajendra Pingale and Raut Hospital to anyone seeking compassionate, skilled, and trustworthy medical care.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Maurya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed with the Treatment Approach

I recently had a deeply disappointing experience at this hospital concerning my mother's health. She was admitted for one day due to a gastric issue. All her reports came back normal, and she was feeling better the next day. Despite this, the doctor insisted on keeping her admitted for an additional three days—without providing a clear medical justification.

When we asked for an explanation, we were told vaguely that she needed antibiotics and "the treatment wasn't complete." It felt more like an excuse to prolong the stay and increase the charges, rather than a decision based on genuine medical necessity.

What’s worse, when I questioned this, the doctor reacted defensively, citing her MBBS degree etc. She then asked me and my father to leave the consultation room, which was both rude and unprofessional.

This experience has left us with serious concerns about the hospital's intentions and patient care ethics. I urge others to seek a second opinion and prioritize preventive healthcare—eat well, stay active, and consult transparent medical professionals who truly have the patient’s best interest at heart.
